summary: Add evidence-wrap and evidence-sign so a machine can record one local check run as a signed note

replay.detail: Runtime claims and replay behavior are unchanged.

schema.detail: No table, schema version or claim registration changes; the notes use the existing v1 evidence format.

rules.detail: Checkpoint and admission rule versions are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Installed st and st2 binaries are unchanged; two new scripts and test fixtures.

downtime.detail: No daemon interruption or restart is required.

manual.detail: Nothing runs until an operator installs evidence-sign behind a sekrets grant with a signing key.

recovery.detail: Deleting the scripts reverses the change; published notes are inert data.
